name: Exhibition Room / English experience gallery
description: Original direction example: the work leads from the first screen and the interface steps back; label-style numbering and exhibition pacing set the rhythm.
variants: Adjust to the user's real body of work and hanging order
contentRequirements: All works, authors and years are original demo content
Real work images and captions come from the user or an explicit confirmation
responsive: 1440px: one lead work with label, then a three-up hang
768px: three-up becomes a single column, labels follow the work
390px: single column, numbering and labels stay legible
interactions: Native anchor navigation and summary disclosure
designDecisions: The first screen holds one work; interface chrome is minimal
Labels carry number, medium and year, never decorative copy
Whitespace follows exhibition pacing rather than even spacing
